rows.title: Blu-ray Review: Adrian Lyne’s Jacob’s Ladder on Lionsgate Home Entertainment
rows.comment: What makes Jacob’s Ladder so <strong>endlessly fascinating
rows.verdict_le10: What makes Jacob’s Ladder so <strong>endlessly fascinating
rows.dek_lead: What makes Jacob’s Ladder so endlessly fascinating, touching, and singular is that it piles on these elusive variations to invoke very real and pointed emotions, an act that we are often quick to take for granted.
